exclusions.name: Other council members or alternates
exclusions.why_safe: The council has exactly five members as per e1; no alternates or substitutes are mentioned. Excluding others is safe because the charter requires votes from the five members only.

exclusions.name: Remote participation
exclusions.why_safe: Council rules require physical presence (e4); no remote participation is allowed. Excluding remote votes is safe.

exclusions.name: Postponement or procedural changes
exclusions.why_safe: Under council rules (e11), an item listed for final action is voted on unless its sponsor moves postponement. Okonkwo wants final action (e5), so postponement is unlikely but not impossible. Excluding postponement as a certainty is safe because the question asks about adoption at the session; if postponed, adoption does not occur, which is consistent with a NO answer.

exclusions.name: Other ordinances or agenda items
exclusions.why_safe: The question is specifically about Ordinance 2026-14; other items do not affect its adoption.
